name: Pokémon Café
intro: A Pokémon-themed café with food and drinks styled after Pokémon characters. Seats are by reservation only, and each day's slots usually go within minutes of release.

facts.bookAhead: About a month: the whole next month opens on the 1st at 18:00 JST

statusNote: The official reservation site opened all of November 2026 at once on October 1 at 18:00 JST. Later months are assumed to follow the same pattern; the site announces each release.
popularityNote: Keyword data (Oct 2025 to Sep 2026): "pokemon cafe reservation" about 5,000 searches a month plus "pokemon cafe reserve" about 500.
difficultyNote: Travel guides (for example thirdeyetraveller.com) report slots going within seconds of release, with the booking site slowing down.
bookingSteps: Open the official reservation site from the Pokémon Café website. The notices are also in English.
Read the notes, tick the consent box and continue.
Choose a date and a time slot.
Enter a phone number and an email address. The café uses them to contact you.
Keep the confirmation email. It has the link to view or cancel your booking.
Arrive 15 minutes before your time (10 minutes for the first 10:40 slot).
visitorTips: Your booking is cancelled automatically if you're 10 minutes late without contacting the café.
Cancel online until 22:00 the day before. On the day, contact the café directly. Goods ordered with the booking are cancelled too.
Booking for someone else, and reselling or transferring a booking, aren't allowed.

soldOut.label: Kirby Café: reservations open on the 10th

faq.q: How far ahead can I book Pokémon Café?
faq.a: A whole month opens at once, on the 1st of the month before, at 18:00 Japan time. For example, all November 2026 dates opened on October 1 at 18:00.

sources.quote: Reservations will open at 6:00 p.m. on Thursday, October 1, 2026. Available Dates: Sunday, November 1 - Monday, November 30, 2026
Please arrive 10 minutes before your reservation only for the first A-seat time slot at 10:40 AM.
